run_Omni3DEvaluationHelper: run Omni3DEvaluationHelper to evaluate 3D object detection predictions across multiple Omni3D dataset splits
create_Omni3DEvaluator: create an Omni3DEvaluator instance to collect and evaluate 2D and 3D bounding box predictions on a dataset
run_Omni3Deval: run Omni3Deval to compute 2D or 3D IoU-based average precision metrics for object detection results
compute_box3d_overlap: compute 3D bounding box IoU overlap between detection and ground truth boxes using box3d_overlap
run_inference_on_dataset: run inference_on_dataset to benchmark model predictions and collect results from a data loader
